defect: Owned-diff credential scanner treated authorization reference identifiers such as delegated_authorization_ref and authorization_binding_ref as literal credentials, blocking non-secret governance reference IDs.
remediation: credential identifier classification excludes only explicit metadata/reference suffixes: _ref, _reference, _id, _digest, _sha256, _fingerprint
direct authorization/api_key/token/password/secret literals remain classified and blocked
negative_space: no literal values or hashes added to evidence
suffix exception applies only to identifier classification, not output secret regex scanning
exhaustion_statement: Authorization reference IDs are no longer misclassified as credentials while direct hardcoded credential literals remain fail-closed.
